channel.title: EU Funding News · Ullswater Investments
channel.description: Daily, verified news on European funding for innovators, researchers and SMEs: Horizon Europe, EIC, Digital Europe, defence, cohesion funds and Spanish R&D grants, with links to the official sources.

item.title: EIT HEI Call 2026: up to €1.25M for university-led deep-tech consortia
item.description: The EIT Higher Education Initiative is funding HEI-led consortia that build deep-tech and manufacturing innovation capacity. Deadline: 13 January 2027.

item.title: EU and India conclude talks on India joining Horizon Europe
item.description: Association is envisaged for January 2027. Indian organisations would then be able to receive funding directly and lead Pillar II collaborative projects.

item.title: EIC 2027 work programme opens over €1.8 billion for deep tech
item.description: The Commission has adopted the EIC's 2027 plan: €578 million for the Accelerator, €248 million for Pathfinder and €100 million for a defence equity call.

item.title: EIC sets 19 November info day on its 2027 funding opportunities
item.description: The online session will present Work Programme 2027 scheme by scheme, from Pathfinder to STEP Defence. Registration closes on 18 November.

item.title: CDTI Innovación commits €12.75 million to 19 R&D+I projects
item.description: All 19 October approvals are loans. Ten companies get CDTI funding for the first time, 15 are SMEs and 13 operations are co-financed by POPE.

item.title: Open Research Europe becomes fee-free in 11 countries
item.description: Researchers in 11 countries can now publish on the Commission's open-access platform without publication fees, under a collective funding model.

item.title: EU and Bpifrance plan €150 million guarantee for Ukraine partnerships
item.description: The arrangement under the Ukraine Investment Framework targets French–Ukrainian industrial ties in defence and dual-use technology.

item.title: Commission proposes €31.7 billion for Ukraine's defence industry
item.description: The proposal covers 2027 under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan. The Council still has to adopt it before disbursements start.

item.title: Canada joins EuroHPC as a Participating State
item.description: Agreed at the EU–Canada Summit in Montreal, the move opens Europe's public supercomputing, AI and quantum resources to Canada.

item.title: Horizon Europe opens 14 'Health' topics for 2027, due 17 February
item.description: HaDEA has published the 2027 'Health' calls, from antivirals and antimicrobials to AI biomarkers and point-of-care diagnostics. Info day on 26 November.

item.title: First EIC defence equity call closes with nine applications
item.description: The EIC STEP Scale Up Defence call offered direct equity of up to €30 million per company; results are expected in early 2027.

item.title: Guidelines on generative AI in research get their largest update
item.description: The ERA Living Guidelines for researchers, research organisations and funders were updated on the same day the first 13 EOSC nodes went live.

item.title: RAISE pledging initiative launched for AI in science
item.description: Companies and philanthropic organisations are invited to support researchers who use AI, mainly with models, computing capacity, software, data and training.

item.title: Horizon Europe Cluster 4 opens its 2027 calls
item.description: Industry, two-stage and RAISE calls opened on 13 October; the digital call on federated and sustainable AI data processing opens on 17 November.

item.title: New €230 million Horizon Europe call on nature
item.description: Ten topics to raise biodiversity spending across Pillar II of the 2026–2027 work programme, with most deadlines on 14 January 2027.
